description: List published Community Days events with the events page's filters, no keyword needed: e.g. upcoming events with an open call for speakers, open registration or sponsorship, by cost, type, country or state, or the events changed since a date (updated_since, with when=all for past and upcoming). Upcoming soonest first; past most recent first; all by start date, oldest first, so when more match than the limit the latest are left out. Answers { events, more, total }: more is true when it left matching events out (with the call or registration filters: when there may be more), and total, given only with more and not with those filters, is how many matched in all; then ask a narrower question (e.g. a later updated_since or another filter) or raise limit. Each event's last_update is when its own team last changed it, or its status last changed (sent for approval, published, cancelled and the like); a fix by a Community Days administrator doesn't move it. Older events may have no last_update, or one a few hours off. Each event's social_links are its own links: each has a platform (such as x, linkedin, meetup or youtube) and a handle, the end of the page's address after the site name; for blog, website and newsletter the handle is the full web address. A newsletter link is the event's newsletter, which people can subscribe to.

call_for_speakers.description: true: only events whose call for speakers is open now

call_for_sponsors.description: true: only events whose call for sponsors is open now

cost.description: Comma-separated: free, low_cost ($30 or less), paid (more than $30)

country.description: Comma-separated two-letter country codes, e.g. us,ca,gb

from.description: With when=range: first start date, yyyy-MM-dd (leave out for no earliest date)

q.description: Optional keyword in the title, city or region (diacritic-insensitive). A state's name also finds events saved under its code ('Tennessee' finds TN); a two-letter code finds that state only

registration_open.description: true: only events whose registration is open now

source.description: all (default), community_days (listed on Community Days) or external (copied from Microsoft's event listings; upcoming and when=all only, as past and range lists leave copied events out)

state.description: One state or province, by code or name, matched exactly: TN and Tennessee both find Tennessee events. A code applies in every country that has it (WA: Washington and Western Australia), so add country to keep to one

to.description: With when=range: last start date, yyyy-MM-dd (leave out for no latest date)

updated_since.description: Only events whose last_update is on or after this: a date such as 2026-11-01 (from the start of that day, UTC) or a time such as 2026-11-18T09:30:00Z (UTC unless it gives an offset, e.g. +02:00). Works with when: add when=all for past events too

when.description: upcoming (default: not ended yet, so events under way today are included), past (already ended), range (from, to or both) or all (past and upcoming, cancelled and postponed included)

name: list_events
